src_text: F. W. Murnau's "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" is itself a remake - an unauthorized adaptation of "Dracula," Bram Stoker's compulsively readable fever dream of a novel - and Murnau and the screenwriter Henrik Galeen retained much of what was arresting about the original while slipping in their own major changes: They're responsible, for example, for the now-set-in-stone tradition that sunlight can destroy the vampire, a notion nowhere in Stoker's book. I likely saw "Nosferatu" at too impressionable an age. I was 6, PBS was showing such things and my babysitter was simply glad I wasn't burning down the house. But I would have been flattened by it whenever I saw it. It was like having felt a draft from a grave. (Its effects were so long-lasting that 30-something years later I published a novel inspired by the film and its production.) The whole thing wasn't so much petrifying as insidiously unsettling, and all of that started with the figure of Nosferatu himself. Max Schreck's performance is, 102 years later, still the benchmark for sinister and dignified repulsiveness. Schreck's vampire has the stillness of a figure in a bad dream or a spider on its web, and the world he inhabits is at times equally disconcerting. After our hero Hutter's first frightening night in Nosferatu's castle, he notices in the mirror that something has bitten his neck, and he smiles.
target_text: F. W. Murnau "Nosferatu: Horrori Sümfoonia" on ise remake – volitamata kohandamine "Dracula"st, Bram Stokeri kirglikult loetavast romaanist – ja Murnau ning stsenaaristi Henrik Galeen säilitasid palju sellest, mis originaalis silmapilku püüdis, kuid lisasid ka oma olulisi muutusi: nad on näiteks vastutavad nüüd kindlaks saanud traditsiooni, et päikesevalgus suudab vampiiri hävitada, mis on mõte, mida Stokeri raamatus ei mainita. Ilmselt nägin "Nosferatut" liiga noores eas. Olin 6-aastane, PBS näitas selliseid asju ja minu lapsehoidja oli lihtsalt õnnelik, et ma ei põletanud maja maha. Kuid see oleks mind igal juhul šokeerinud, olenemata sellest, millal ma seda nägin. See oli nagu oleksin tundnud tuulepuhangut haudast. (Selle mõju oli nii püsiv, et 30 aastat hiljem avaldasin romaani, mis oli inspireeritud filmist ja selle tootmisest.) Kogu see kogemus ei olnud nii väga hirmutav, kui pigem salakavalalt häiriv, ja see kõik algas Nosferatu figuurist. Max Schreki esitus on 102 aasta pärast endiselt mõõdupuu süngeks ja väärikaks vastikumuseks. Schreki vampiiril on unenäo figuuri või ämbliku võrgus oleva olendi rahulikkus, ja maailm, kus ta elab, on mõnikord sama häiriv. Pärast meie kangelase Hutteri esmast hirmutavat ööd Nosferatu lossis märkab ta peeglis, et midagi on tema kaela hammustanud, ja ta naeratab.

src_text: South African opener Matthew Breetzke etched his name into the record books by becoming the first batter to score 150 runs on ODI debut in second match of the ongoing tri-series against New Zealand at the Gaddafi Stadium on Monday. His stunning knock of 150 off 148 balls, laced with 11 fours and five sixes, surpassed the previous record held by the legendary West Indies' batter Desmond Haynes, who scored 148 in his maiden ODI innings against Australia back in 1978. Before Breetzke's innings, the highest score on ODI debut for South Africa was 124 by Colin Ingram against Zimbabwe in 2010. Now, Breetzke stands alone at the top, delivering a performance that showcased patience, aggression, and remarkable shot selection as South Africa posted a mammoth 304/6.

Tignar frammistaður hans, 150 stig úr 148 boltum, með ellefu fjórum og fimm sexa, sló út um það met Desmond Haynesar, frægs leikmanns Vestur-Indía, sem skoraði 148 stig í sínum fyrsta ODI-leik gegn Ástralíu árið 1978. Áður en Breetzke lék, var metið fyrir hæsta stig í ODI-debutt fyrir Suðurafríku 124 stig af Colin Ingram gegn Simbabve árið 2010. Nú stendur Breetzke einn á toppnum, með frammistöðu sem sýndi þolinni, skarphegðun og óvenjulega val á skot þegar Suðurafríka náði mikilli stigahæð: 304/6.

src_text: I've always thought that one of the most insoluble aesthetic problems going is remaking a movie masterpiece. I certainly understand the impulse to passionately re-engage such a work, but if the definition of a masterwork is something peerless at what it sought to accomplish, how do you remake it without simply reiterating it? There's a reason no one has tried second versions of Fellini's "8½" or Coppola's "The Godfather" or Polanski's "Chinatown." In the case of Fellini's achievement, is someone going to produce a more harrowing portrait of the self-deluding toxicity of male narcissism? In the case of Coppola's, of the corrosive effects of power? Or in the case of Polanski's, of the Hey-nothing-personal malevolence of late-model capitalism? (Water itself in that movie turns out to be the commodity that's manipulated for profit.)
target_text: Одувек сам мислио да је један од најнерешивијих естетских проблема данашњице прављење римејка филмског ремек-дела. Свакако разумем порив да се човек страствено поново упусти у такво дело, али ако је дефиниција ремек-дела нешто што је без премца у ономе што је желело да постигне, како направити римејк а не поновити га просто? Постоји разлог зашто нико није покушао да сними другу верзију Фелинијевог „8½“, Кополиног „Кума“ или Поланскијеве „Кинеске четврти“. У случају Фелинијевог остварења, да ли ће неко створити мучнији портрет самообмањујуће токсичности мушког нарцизма? У случају Кополиног, корозивних ефеката моћи? Или у случају Поланскијевог, злонамерности касног капитализма у стилу „хеј, ништа лично“? (Испоставља се да је у том филму сама вода роба којом се манипулише ради профита.)

src_text: South African opener Matthew Breetzke etched his name into the record books by becoming the first batter to score 150 runs on ODI debut in second match of the ongoing tri-series against New Zealand at the Gaddafi Stadium on Monday. His stunning knock of 150 off 148 balls, laced with 11 fours and five sixes, surpassed the previous record held by the legendary West Indies' batter Desmond Haynes, who scored 148 in his maiden ODI innings against Australia back in 1978. Before Breetzke's innings, the highest score on ODI debut for South Africa was 124 by Colin Ingram against Zimbabwe in 2010. Now, Breetzke stands alone at the top, delivering a performance that showcased patience, aggression, and remarkable shot selection as South Africa posted a mammoth 304/6.
target_text: Jihoafrický úvodní pálkař Matthew Breetzke se zapsal do historie, když se v druhém zápase probíhajícího turnaje proti Novému Zélandu, který se konal v pondělí na stadionu Gaddafi, stal prvním hráčem, který při svém debutu v mezinárodním kriketu (ODI) dosáhl skóre 150 bodů. Jeho úžasný výkon, kdy získal 150 bodů ze 148 odpalů, včetně 11 čtyřek a pěti šestek, překonal předchozí rekord, který držel legendární hráč z týmu Západních Indií, Desmond Haynes, který v roce 1978 při svém debutu v ODI proti Austrálii získal 148 bodů. Před Breetzkeho výkonem bylo nejvyšším skóre při debutu v ODI za Jihoafrickou republiku 124 bodů, které získal Colin Ingram proti Zimbabwe v roce 2010. Nyní Breetzke stojí osamocen na vrcholu, a jeho výkon, který se vyznačoval trpělivostí, agresivitou a vynikající volbou úderů, pomohl Jihoafrické republice dosáhnout impozantního skóre 304/6.

src_text: When it comes to those who have waded into that kind of deep water, some have tried the Let's-really-shake-things-up solution. There's the lamentable 1962 remake of "The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari," for instance, which not only eliminated the central figure of Cesare the somnambulist but also featured a Caligari who instead of practicing diabolic hypnotism spent his time showing the heroine offensive pictures. Other filmmakers have chosen the even more baffling route of changing almost nothing, such as Gus Van Sant's nearly shot-for-shot 1998 remake of "Psycho." The number of disappointed moviegoers you risk in remaking a masterpiece from 1922 is smaller, for obvious reasons, but even so, the director Robert Eggers has made clear in any number of interviews his understanding that his new "Nosferatu" is re-engaging one of the greatest of the silent movies. (In 2016, when he was first attempting to remake the film, he told an interviewer that it felt "ugly and blasphemous and egomaniacal and disgusting" to take up that project so early into his career.)

src_text: F. W. Murnau's "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" is itself a remake - an unauthorized adaptation of "Dracula," Bram Stoker's compulsively readable fever dream of a novel - and Murnau and the screenwriter Henrik Galeen retained much of what was arresting about the original while slipping in their own major changes: They're responsible, for example, for the now-set-in-stone tradition that sunlight can destroy the vampire, a notion nowhere in Stoker's book. I likely saw "Nosferatu" at too impressionable an age. I was 6, PBS was showing such things and my babysitter was simply glad I wasn't burning down the house. But I would have been flattened by it whenever I saw it. It was like having felt a draft from a grave. (Its effects were so long-lasting that 30-something years later I published a novel inspired by the film and its production.) The whole thing wasn't so much petrifying as insidiously unsettling, and all of that started with the figure of Nosferatu himself. Max Schreck's performance is, 102 years later, still the benchmark for sinister and dignified repulsiveness. Schreck's vampire has the stillness of a figure in a bad dream or a spider on its web, and the world he inhabits is at times equally disconcerting. After our hero Hutter's first frightening night in Nosferatu's castle, he notices in the mirror that something has bitten his neck, and he smiles.
target_text: "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" eftir F. W. Murnau er í sjálfu sér endurgerð – óleyfileg aðlögun af skáldsögunni "Dracula" eftir Bram Stoker, sem er ákaflega spennandi og áhrifamikil – og Murnau og handritshöfundurinn, Henrik Galeen, héldu að miklu leyti við það sem var svo áhrifamikið við upprunalegu útgáfuna, á sama tíma og þeir gerðu viðamiklar breytingar: Til dæmis eru þeir ábygðir fyrir þá hefð sem nú er orðið að staðreyndi að sólin getur eytt vampírum, en þetta hugtak kemur ekki fyrir í bókinni eftir Stoker. Ég hef líklega séð "Nosferatu" á of viðkvæmu aldri. Ég var 6 ára, sjónvarpsstöðin PBS sýndi slíkt efni og barnastjórnandinn minn var bara ánægð með að ég hefði ekki kveikt í húsinu. En það hefði haft mikil áhrif á mig, hvenær sem ég hefði séð það. Það var eins og að hafa fundið fyrir köldu vindinum úr gröft. (Áhrifin voru svo langvarandi að þrjátíu árum síðar gaf ég út skáldsögu sem var innblásin af þessari mynd og framleiðslu hennar.) Allt þetta var ekki svo mikið skelfilegt heldur frekar óþægilegt og þetta allt hófst með persónunni, Nosferatu sjálfum. Framleiðsla Max Schreck er, 102 árum síðar, enn viðmiðið fyrir því sem er skelfilegt og samt sem áður virðulegt. Vampíran hans Schreck er eins og lík í illri draumi eða könguló á vefnum sínum, og heimurinn sem hann býr í er stundum jafn óþægilegur. Eftir fyrstu skelfilegu nótt Hutter í kastalinu hjá Nosferatu, tekur hann eftir í spegli að eitthvað hefur bitið hann í hálsi, og hann brosir.

Dne 20.06. kolem 10:30 jsem se vydal z Kolína směrem na Prahu po silnice. Po skončení úseku s kamerami v oblasti Úval, při předjíždění aut vpředu jsem překročil rychlost 90 km/h, rozumím tomu, ale nikoho jsem ne omezil a neohrožil, po předjetí jsem shodil rychlost, ale najednou v protisměru, s průsečíkem plných čar, vyjelo vozidlo na mně. Abych se vyhnul srážce, zatočil jsem doprava a pokračoval směrem k pracovníkům na dálnici. Abych se vyhnul srážce s nimi, jsem zatočil do odbočky.
Nemohl jsem moc zpomalit, protože jsem se bál silného a nekontrolovaného smyku na trávě. Z důvodu, abych zabránil vážnějším následkům, bylo mé vozidlo poškozeno a není opravitelné.. Myslím si, že poškození ve výši 180 000 Kč , zejména s ohledem na okolnosti, kdy jsem byl nucen se vyhnout jiným vážným následkům a odjet do odbočky.

Am 20.06. gegen 10:30 Uhr fuhr ich von Kolín in Richtung Prag auf der Straße. Nach dem Ende des Abschnitts mit Kameras in der Gegend von Úval überholte ich bei einer Geschwindigkeit von über 90 km/h die vor mir fahrenden Autos. Ich verstehe, dass das nicht erlaubt ist, aber ich habe niemanden behindert oder gefährdet. Nach dem Überholen reduzierte ich die Geschwindigkeit, doch plötzlich kam mir ein Fahrzeug auf der Gegenfahrbahn entgegen, das die durchgezogene Linie überfuhr. Um einen Zusammenstoß zu vermeiden, lenkte ich nach rechts und fuhr in Richtung der Arbeiter auf der Autobahn. Um einen Zusammenstoß mit ihnen zu vermeiden, bog ich in eine Abzweigung ein.
Ich konnte nicht stark bremsen, weil ich einen starken und unkontrollierten Schleuder auf dem Gras befürchtete. Um schwerwiegendere Folgen zu verhindern, wurde mein Fahrzeug beschädigt und ist nicht mehr reparierbar. Ich schätze den Schaden auf etwa 180.000 CZK, insbesondere unter Berücksichtigung der Umstände, da ich gezwungen war, anderen schwerwiegenden Folgen auszuweichen und in die Abzweigung zu fahren.

src_text: When it comes to those who have waded into that kind of deep water, some have tried the Let's-really-shake-things-up solution. There's the lamentable 1962 remake of "The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari," for instance, which not only eliminated the central figure of Cesare the somnambulist but also featured a Caligari who instead of practicing diabolic hypnotism spent his time showing the heroine offensive pictures. Other filmmakers have chosen the even more baffling route of changing almost nothing, such as Gus Van Sant's nearly shot-for-shot 1998 remake of "Psycho." The number of disappointed moviegoers you risk in remaking a masterpiece from 1922 is smaller, for obvious reasons, but even so, the director Robert Eggers has made clear in any number of interviews his understanding that his new "Nosferatu" is re-engaging one of the greatest of the silent movies. (In 2016, when he was first attempting to remake the film, he told an interviewer that it felt "ugly and blasphemous and egomaniacal and disgusting" to take up that project so early into his career.)

src_text: But the most destabilizing figure might well be Hutter's wife, Ellen, our heroine, who's again and again shown to be telepathically on the monster's wavelength, even when he's thousands of miles away, so that polarities like good and evil or desire and repulsion seem to just evaporate while we watch. That last aspect alone would seem to land this story in Robert Eggers's wheelhouse. Part of the subversive energy of movies like "The Witch," "The Lighthouse" and "The Northman" derives from what feels like modern takes on historical characters in thrall to dark passions so that the distantly historical is both granted its strangeness and animated by a scrutinizing modern sensibility. At its best, his version both evokes and reconceives Murnau's most brilliant visual ideas. Murnau's masterful use of the opacities of dark archways from which the vampire can emerge and into which he can dissolve is both echoed and made new. Murnau's famously arresting use of shadows to visualize the vampire's defiling reach is reimagined when those shadows in this new version extend themselves in a 360-degree pan that evokes their vertiginous inescapability. And the shadow of the vampire's hand now extends across the entire city, repurposing the most memorable image from Murnau's "Faust."

src_text: South African opener Matthew Breetzke etched his name into the record books by becoming the first batter to score 150 runs on ODI debut in second match of the ongoing tri-series against New Zealand at the Gaddafi Stadium on Monday. His stunning knock of 150 off 148 balls, laced with 11 fours and five sixes, surpassed the previous record held by the legendary West Indies' batter Desmond Haynes, who scored 148 in his maiden ODI innings against Australia back in 1978. Before Breetzke's innings, the highest score on ODI debut for South Africa was 124 by Colin Ingram against Zimbabwe in 2010. Now, Breetzke stands alone at the top, delivering a performance that showcased patience, aggression, and remarkable shot selection as South Africa posted a mammoth 304/6.
target_text: У понеділок на стадіоні Каддафі під час другого матчу трисерійного турніру проти Нової Зеландії південноафриканський відкриваючий бетсмен Метью Бріцке вписав своє ім’я в історію, ставши першим гравцем, який набрав 150 रन у своєму дебютному ODI-матчі. Його вражаючий іннінг — 150 रन за 148 м’ячів, з яких 11 були чотирибаловими ударами та п’ять — шестибаловими, — перевершив попередній рекорд, встановлений легендарним бетсменом збірної Вест-Індії Десмондом Хейнсом, який у 1978 році набрав 148 रन у своєму дебютному ODI-матчі проти Австралії. Перед іннінгом Бріцке найвищим результатом у дебютному ODI-матчі за збірну Південної Африки були 124 रनи Коліна Інграма у грі проти Зімбабве у 2010 році. Тепер Бріцке одноосібно очолює список, продемонструвавши гру, яка поєднує терпіння, агресивність та вражаючий вибір ударів, завдяки чому збірна Південної Африки набрала вражаючі 304/6.

Es wird zum Fixieren verwendet, wenn die Fraktur an einem oberen Gliedmaßen liegt.
Bei einer Fraktur im Beckenbereich muss die verletzte Person stabilisiert und so schnell wie möglich zu einem Arzt gebracht werden.
Frakturen werden in geschlossene und offene Frakturen unterteilt.
Eine Schiene muss immer zwei Gelenke umfassen, eines oberhalb und eines unterhalb der Frakturstelle.
Ein Knochensplitter, der aus der Wunde ragt, muss steril abgedeckt werden.
Eine geschlossene Fraktur ist eine, bei der die Haut über der Frakturstelle nicht verletzt ist.
Als Schiene kann alles verwendet werden, was zur Hand ist, z. B. ein Gürtel.
Bei einer Fraktur eines Gliedmaßes muss das Gliedmaß zunächst in seine ursprüngliche Position zurückgebracht werden.
Wenn es im Winter zu einer Fraktur kommt, dürfen Kleidung, Schuhe oder Handschuhe auf keinen Fall ausgezogen werden, damit das geschwollene Gewebe nicht erfriert.
In Notfällen kann ein Gliedmaß fixiert werden, indem es an ein anderes Gliedmaß gebunden wird.

src_text: F. W. Murnau's "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" is itself a remake - an unauthorized adaptation of "Dracula," Bram Stoker's compulsively readable fever dream of a novel - and Murnau and the screenwriter Henrik Galeen retained much of what was arresting about the original while slipping in their own major changes: They're responsible, for example, for the now-set-in-stone tradition that sunlight can destroy the vampire, a notion nowhere in Stoker's book. I likely saw "Nosferatu" at too impressionable an age. I was 6, PBS was showing such things and my babysitter was simply glad I wasn't burning down the house. But I would have been flattened by it whenever I saw it. It was like having felt a draft from a grave. (Its effects were so long-lasting that 30-something years later I published a novel inspired by the film and its production.) The whole thing wasn't so much petrifying as insidiously unsettling, and all of that started with the figure of Nosferatu himself. Max Schreck's performance is, 102 years later, still the benchmark for sinister and dignified repulsiveness. Schreck's vampire has the stillness of a figure in a bad dream or a spider on its web, and the world he inhabits is at times equally disconcerting. After our hero Hutter's first frightening night in Nosferatu's castle, he notices in the mirror that something has bitten his neck, and he smiles.

Вероватно сам гледао „Носфератуа“ у превише рањивом добу. Имао сам 6 година, PBS је приказивао такве ствари, а моја дадиља је једноставно била срећна што не палим кућу. Цела ствар није била толико застрашујућа колико подмукло узнемирујућа, а све је то почело са самом фигуром Носфератуа. src_text: When it comes to those who have waded into that kind of deep water, some have tried the Let's-really-shake-things-up solution. There's the lamentable 1962 remake of "The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari," for instance, which not only eliminated the central figure of Cesare the somnambulist but also featured a Caligari who instead of practicing diabolic hypnotism spent his time showing the heroine offensive pictures. Other filmmakers have chosen the even more baffling route of changing almost nothing, such as Gus Van Sant's nearly shot-for-shot 1998 remake of "Psycho." The number of disappointed moviegoers you risk in remaking a masterpiece from 1922 is smaller, for obvious reasons, but even so, the director Robert Eggers has made clear in any number of interviews his understanding that his new "Nosferatu" is re-engaging one of the greatest of the silent movies. (In 2016, when he was first attempting to remake the film, he told an interviewer that it felt "ugly and blasphemous and egomaniacal and disgusting" to take up that project so early into his career.)
target_text: 当涉及到那些涉足这种深水区的人时，有些人尝试了"让我们真正颠覆一切"的解决方案。例如，令人遗憾的1962年《卡里加里博士的小屋》重拍版，不仅删除了梦游者塞萨尔这一核心人物，还让卡里加里不再练习恶魔催眠术，而是花时间向女主角展示令人不快的图片。其他电影制作人选择了更加令人困惑的路线，几乎不改变任何东西，比如格斯·范·桑特1998年几乎逐镜头重拍的《惊魂记》。重拍1922年杰作时你冒险让失望的观众数量更少，原因显而易见，但即便如此，导演罗伯特·埃格斯在许多采访中都明确表示，他理解自己的新版《诺斯费拉图》是在重新诠释最伟大的默片之一。（2016年，当他首次尝试重拍这部电影时，他告诉采访者，在职业生涯如此早期就承担这个项目感觉"丑陋、亵渎、自大和恶心"。）

src_text: F. W. Murnau's "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" is itself a remake - an unauthorized adaptation of "Dracula," Bram Stoker's compulsively readable fever dream of a novel - and Murnau and the screenwriter Henrik Galeen retained much of what was arresting about the original while slipping in their own major changes: They're responsible, for example, for the now-set-in-stone tradition that sunlight can destroy the vampire, a notion nowhere in Stoker's book. I likely saw "Nosferatu" at too impressionable an age. I was 6, PBS was showing such things and my babysitter was simply glad I wasn't burning down the house. But I would have been flattened by it whenever I saw it. It was like having felt a draft from a grave. (Its effects were so long-lasting that 30-something years later I published a novel inspired by the film and its production.) The whole thing wasn't so much petrifying as insidiously unsettling, and all of that started with the figure of Nosferatu himself. Max Schreck's performance is, 102 years later, still the benchmark for sinister and dignified repulsiveness. Schreck's vampire has the stillness of a figure in a bad dream or a spider on its web, and the world he inhabits is at times equally disconcerting. After our hero Hutter's first frightening night in Nosferatu's castle, he notices in the mirror that something has bitten his neck, and he smiles.

src_text: I've always thought that one of the most insoluble aesthetic problems going is remaking a movie masterpiece. I certainly understand the impulse to passionately re-engage such a work, but if the definition of a masterwork is something peerless at what it sought to accomplish, how do you remake it without simply reiterating it? There's a reason no one has tried second versions of Fellini's "8½" or Coppola's "The Godfather" or Polanski's "Chinatown." In the case of Fellini's achievement, is someone going to produce a more harrowing portrait of the self-deluding toxicity of male narcissism? In the case of Coppola's, of the corrosive effects of power? Or in the case of Polanski's, of the Hey-nothing-personal malevolence of late-model capitalism? (Water itself in that movie turns out to be the commodity that's manipulated for profit.)

src_text: South African opener Matthew Breetzke etched his name into the record books by becoming the first batter to score 150 runs on ODI debut in second match of the ongoing tri-series against New Zealand at the Gaddafi Stadium on Monday. His stunning knock of 150 off 148 balls, laced with 11 fours and five sixes, surpassed the previous record held by the legendary West Indies' batter Desmond Haynes, who scored 148 in his maiden ODI innings against Australia back in 1978. Before Breetzke's innings, the highest score on ODI debut for South Africa was 124 by Colin Ingram against Zimbabwe in 2010. Now, Breetzke stands alone at the top, delivering a performance that showcased patience, aggression, and remarkable shot selection as South Africa posted a mammoth 304/6.

Stalo se tak v pondělí ve druhém utkání probíhajícího trojutkání proti Novému Zélandu na stadionu Gaddáfí. Jeho ohromující výkon – 150 běhů ze 148 míčů, včetně 11 čtyřek a pěti šestek – překonal dosavadní rekord, který držel legendární pálkař West Indies Desmond Haynes, který v roce 1978 při svém prvním ODI zápase v Austrálii zaznamenal 148 běhů. Do Breetzkeho nástupu bylo nejvyšší skóre při debutu v ODI za Jihoafrickou republiku 124 běhů, které v roce 2010 zaznamenal Colin Ingram proti Zimbabwe. Nyní Breetzke stojí na vrcholu. Trojcípý šátek.
Používá se k zavěšení, pokud se zlomenina nachází na horní končetině.
Při zlomenině v oblasti pánve je nutné uložit zraněného do stabilizované polohy a co nejrychleji odvézt k lékaři.
Zlomeniny se dělí na zavřené a volné.
Dlaha musí jít vždy přes dva klouby, jeden nad a jeden pod zlomeným místem.
Úlomek kosti vyčnívající z rány musí být sterilně zakryt.
Zavřená zlomenina je taková, kdy kůže nad zlomeninou není porušena.
Jako dlahu lze použít vše, co máme po ruce, např. opasek.
Při zlomenině končetiny je potřeba nejprve vrátit končetinu do původní polohy.
Pokud dojde ke zlomenině v zimě, zásadně nesundáváme oděvy, boty či rukavice, aby oteklá tkáň neomrzla.
V nouzovém případě je možné končetinu znehybnit tím, že ji přivážeme k druhé končetině.

Трохкутова пов’язка.
Використовується для підвішування, якщо перелом знаходиться на верхній кінцівці.
При переломі в області тазу необхідно покласти потерпілого в стабілізоване положення та якомога швидше відвезти до лікаря.
Переломи поділяються на закриті та відкриті.
Шина повинна йти завжди через два суглоби, один над і один під місцем перелому.
Уламок кістки, що виступає з рани, необхідно стерильно закрити.
Закритий перелом – це такий, коли шкіра над переломом не пошкоджена.
Як шину можна використати все, що є під рукою, наприклад, ремінь.
При переломі кінцівки потрібно спочатку повернути кінцівку в початкове положення.
Якщо стався перелом взимку, категорично не знімаємо одяг, взуття чи рукавиці, щоб набрякла тканина не обморозилася.
У надзвичайному випадку можна знерухомити кінцівку, прив’язавши її до іншої кінцівки.

src_text: But the most destabilizing figure might well be Hutter's wife, Ellen, our heroine, who's again and again shown to be telepathically on the monster's wavelength, even when he's thousands of miles away, so that polarities like good and evil or desire and repulsion seem to just evaporate while we watch. That last aspect alone would seem to land this story in Robert Eggers's wheelhouse. Part of the subversive energy of movies like "The Witch," "The Lighthouse" and "The Northman" derives from what feels like modern takes on historical characters in thrall to dark passions so that the distantly historical is both granted its strangeness and animated by a scrutinizing modern sensibility. At its best, his version both evokes and reconceives Murnau's most brilliant visual ideas. Murnau's masterful use of the opacities of dark archways from which the vampire can emerge and into which he can dissolve is both echoed and made new. Murnau's famously arresting use of shadows to visualize the vampire's defiling reach is reimagined when those shadows in this new version extend themselves in a 360-degree pan that evokes their vertiginous inescapability. And the shadow of the vampire's hand now extends across the entire city, repurposing the most memorable image from Murnau's "Faust."
target_text: En sú persóna sem veldur mestum óstöðugleika gæti vel verið eiginkona Hutters, Ellen, hetjan okkar, sem aftur og aftur sýnir sig vera á bylgjulengd skrímslisins með hugsunum, jafnvel þegar hann er þúsundir kílómetra í burtu, þannig að pólar eins og gott og illt eða löngun og fráhvarf virðast bara gufa upp á meðan við horfum á.Sá síðastnefndi þáttur einn og sér virðist koma þessari sögu í stjórn Roberts Eggers.Hluti af þeirri byltingarkenndu orku sem býr í kvikmyndum eins og „Norninni“, „Vitinum“ og „Norðmanninum“ á rætur að rekja til þess sem virðist vera nútímalegar túlkanir á sögulegum persónum sem eru undirorpnar dökkum ástríðum, þannig að hið fjarlæga sögulega fær bæði sinn sérstaka blæ og lífgast með rannsakandi nútímanæmi.Þegar best lætur bæði vekur útgáfa hans upp og endurhugsar snilldarlegustu sjónrænu hugmyndir Murnaus.Meistaraleg notkun Murnaus á ógegnsæi dökkra bogagátta, þar sem vampíran getur komið út og leystst upp í, bæði endurómuð og gerð að nýju.Fræg notkun Murnau á skuggum til að sjá fyrir sér óhreina umfang vampírunnar er endurhugsuð þegar skuggarnir í þessari nýju útgáfu teygja sig út í 360 gráðu beygju sem vekur upp svimandi óumflýjanleika þeirra.Og skuggi handar vampírunnar nær nú yfir alla borgina og endurnýtir eftirminnilegustu myndina úr „Faust“ eftir Murnau.

src_text: When it comes to those who have waded into that kind of deep water, some have tried the Let's-really-shake-things-up solution. There's the lamentable 1962 remake of "The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari," for instance, which not only eliminated the central figure of Cesare the somnambulist but also featured a Caligari who instead of practicing diabolic hypnotism spent his time showing the heroine offensive pictures. Other filmmakers have chosen the even more baffling route of changing almost nothing, such as Gus Van Sant's nearly shot-for-shot 1998 remake of "Psycho." The number of disappointed moviegoers you risk in remaking a masterpiece from 1922 is smaller, for obvious reasons, but even so, the director Robert Eggers has made clear in any number of interviews his understanding that his new "Nosferatu" is re-engaging one of the greatest of the silent movies. (In 2016, when he was first attempting to remake the film, he told an interviewer that it felt "ugly and blasphemous and egomaniacal and disgusting" to take up that project so early into his career.)

src_text: When it comes to those who have waded into that kind of deep water, some have tried the Let's-really-shake-things-up solution. There's the lamentable 1962 remake of "The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari," for instance, which not only eliminated the central figure of Cesare the somnambulist but also featured a Caligari who instead of practicing diabolic hypnotism spent his time showing the heroine offensive pictures. Other filmmakers have chosen the even more baffling route of changing almost nothing, such as Gus Van Sant's nearly shot-for-shot 1998 remake of "Psycho." The number of disappointed moviegoers you risk in remaking a masterpiece from 1922 is smaller, for obvious reasons, but even so, the director Robert Eggers has made clear in any number of interviews his understanding that his new "Nosferatu" is re-engaging one of the greatest of the silent movies. (In 2016, when he was first attempting to remake the film, he told an interviewer that it felt "ugly and blasphemous and egomaniacal and disgusting" to take up that project so early into his career.)
target_text: Pokud jde o ty, kteří se do těchto hlubokých vod pustili, někteří zvolili řešení „opravdu to rozčeřit“. Například politováníhodný remake „Kabinetu doktora Caligariho“ z roku 1962, který nejenže odstranil ústřední postavu Cesareho náměsíčníka, ale také představil Caligariho, který místo ďábelského hypnotizování trávil čas ukazováním urážlivých obrázků hlavní hrdince. Jiní filmaři zvolili ještě záhadnější cestu téměř žádných změn, jako například Gus Van Sant ve svém téměř záběr po záběru identickém remaku „Psycha“ z roku 1998. Počet zklamaných diváků, které riskujete při předělání mistrovského díla z roku 1922, je z pochopitelných důvodů menší, ale i tak režisér Robert Eggers v řadě rozhovorů jasně deklaroval, že jeho nový „Nosferatu“ znovu otevírá jedno z největších němých filmových děl. (V roce 2016, kdy se o remake poprvé pokoušel, řekl v jednom rozhovoru, že mu připadá „ošklivé, rouhačské, egomaniakální a odporné“ pouštět se do takového projektu tak brzy ve své kariéře.)

src_text: I've always thought that one of the most insoluble aesthetic problems going is remaking a movie masterpiece. I certainly understand the impulse to passionately re-engage such a work, but if the definition of a masterwork is something peerless at what it sought to accomplish, how do you remake it without simply reiterating it? There's a reason no one has tried second versions of Fellini's "8½" or Coppola's "The Godfather" or Polanski's "Chinatown." In the case of Fellini's achievement, is someone going to produce a more harrowing portrait of the self-deluding toxicity of male narcissism? In the case of Coppola's, of the corrosive effects of power? Or in the case of Polanski's, of the Hey-nothing-personal malevolence of late-model capitalism? (Water itself in that movie turns out to be the commodity that's manipulated for profit.)
target_text: Mul on alati tundunud, et üks kõige keerulisem lahendatav esteetiline probleem on filmiklassika uuesti tegemine. Mõistan, et tekib tung sellesse teosesse taas tulihingeliselt sisse elada, kuid kui filmiklassikat määratletakse teosena, mis on oma eesmärgi saavutamisel ületamatu, siis kuidas seda uuesti teha, ilma et seda lihtsalt korrataks? Seetõttu pole kunagi proovitud Fellini „8 1/2“, Coppola’i „Godfatheri“ ega Polanski „Chinatowni“ teisest korda. Kas Fellini meistriteose puhul loodab keegi luua enesepettuse ja meeste narruseni ulatuva toksilisuse hirmsama kirjelduse? Või Coppola’i puhul võimu korrodeerivate tagajärgede? Või Polanski puhul tänapäeva kapitalismi vastutustundetu pahatahtlikkuse? (Selle filmiga kujutatakse vett kaubaks, mida kasumi saamiseks kasutatakse manipuleerimiseks.)

src_text: F. W. Murnau's "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" is itself a remake - an unauthorized adaptation of "Dracula," Bram Stoker's compulsively readable fever dream of a novel - and Murnau and the screenwriter Henrik Galeen retained much of what was arresting about the original while slipping in their own major changes: They're responsible, for example, for the now-set-in-stone tradition that sunlight can destroy the vampire, a notion nowhere in Stoker's book. I likely saw "Nosferatu" at too impressionable an age. I was 6, PBS was showing such things and my babysitter was simply glad I wasn't burning down the house. But I would have been flattened by it whenever I saw it. It was like having felt a draft from a grave. (Its effects were so long-lasting that 30-something years later I published a novel inspired by the film and its production.) The whole thing wasn't so much petrifying as insidiously unsettling, and all of that started with the figure of Nosferatu himself. Max Schreck's performance is, 102 years later, still the benchmark for sinister and dignified repulsiveness. Schreck's vampire has the stillness of a figure in a bad dream or a spider on its web, and the world he inhabits is at times equally disconcerting. After our hero Hutter's first frightening night in Nosferatu's castle, he notices in the mirror that something has bitten his neck, and he smiles.
target_text: "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" e F. W. Murnau náa enkítodúáre átaá - enkítodúáre náa méeta enkíyíóóloito e "Dracula," enkítápúkúyíá e Bram Stoker náa éítasómisho oltúngáná átaá te nkóító - náa óotámá Murnau na olóréwá enkíréwáto Henrik Galeen pookí kítók naítamanyá te nkítashé kátáa éítúlusóoyie nkításhukóret áánik pookí naílang'a: náa enyíáát áánik, te enáishoóto, enkítáalare naítóbírí sáá ólóng náa éíshoó enkólóng' áár olámáyíánî, enkíshui náa méeta te nkítápúkúyíá e Stoker. Áíshooríé "Nosferatu" te sáá náa áítamanyíshóyieki átaá. Áatáa ilapá 6, éishoó PBS nkíshúí énoto náa óotóná oltáamátáni láyíók áíyíólo náa máár enkang'. Káké áítamanyáki átaá te sáá pookí náa áíshooríé. Énáa átaá áípiik enkáík enkolóng' e nkúpa. (Nkínotot áánik óotóná átaá náa áítodúáki enkítápúkúyíá te ilapá 30-okúni te sinema énoto na enkínototo enye.) Pookí kítók méenáa átaá náa éítúruo káké éítasílang'a te nkóító, náa pookí énoto éítashe enkolóng' e Nosferatu átaá. Enkínototo e Max Schreck náa, te ilapá 102, enkíshúí e nkínototo e enkóító naítóbírí naítakútukúny. src_text: F. W. Murnau's "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" is itself a remake - an unauthorized adaptation of "Dracula," Bram Stoker's compulsively readable fever dream of a novel - and Murnau and the screenwriter Henrik Galeen retained much of what was arresting about the original while slipping in their own major changes: They're responsible, for example, for the now-set-in-stone tradition that sunlight can destroy the vampire, a notion nowhere in Stoker's book. I likely saw "Nosferatu" at too impressionable an age. I was 6, PBS was showing such things and my babysitter was simply glad I wasn't burning down the house. But I would have been flattened by it whenever I saw it. It was like having felt a draft from a grave. (Its effects were so long-lasting that 30-something years later I published a novel inspired by the film and its production.) The whole thing wasn't so much petrifying as insidiously unsettling, and all of that started with the figure of Nosferatu himself. Max Schreck's performance is, 102 years later, still the benchmark for sinister and dignified repulsiveness. Schreck's vampire has the stillness of a figure in a bad dream or a spider on its web, and the world he inhabits is at times equally disconcerting. After our hero Hutter's first frightening night in Nosferatu's castle, he notices in the mirror that something has bitten his neck, and he smiles.

Part of the subversive energy of movies like "The Witch," "The Lighthouse" and "The Northman" derives from what feels like modern takes on historical characters in thrall to dark passions so that the distantly historical is both granted its strangeness and animated by a scrutinizing modern sensibility. At its best, his version both evokes and reconceives Murnau's most brilliant visual ideas. Murnau's masterful use of the opacities of dark archways from which the vampire can emerge and into which he can dissolve is both echoed and made new. Murnau's famously arresting use of shadows to visualize the vampire's defiling reach is reimagined when those shadows in this new version extend themselves in a 360-degree pan that evokes their vertiginous inescapability. Dne 20.06. kolem 10:30 jsem se vydal z Kolína směrem na Prahu po silnice. Po skončení úseku s kamerami v oblasti Úval, při předjíždění aut vpředu jsem překročil rychlost 90 km/h, rozumím tomu, ale nikoho jsem ne omezil a neohrožil, po předjetí jsem shodil rychlost, ale najednou v protisměru, s průsečíkem plných čar, vyjelo vozidlo na mně. Abych se vyhnul srážce, zatočil jsem doprava a pokračoval směrem k pracovníkům na dálnici. Abych se vyhnul srážce s nimi, jsem zatočil do odbočky.
Nemohl jsem moc zpomalit, protože jsem se bál silného a nekontrolovaného smyku na trávě. Z důvodu, abych zabránil vážnějším následkům, bylo mé vozidlo poškozeno a není opravitelné.. Myslím si, že poškození ve výši 180 000 Kč , zejména s ohledem na okolnosti, kdy jsem byl nucen se vyhnout jiným vážným následkům a odjet do odbočky.
target_text: Am 20.06. gegen 10:30 Uhr fuhr ich von Kolín in Richtung Prag auf der Straße. Nach dem Abschnitt mit Kameras in der Gegend von Úval, als ich Autos vor mir überholte, überschritt ich die Geschwindigkeit von 90 km/h, ich verstehe das, aber ich habe niemanden behindert oder gefährdet, nach dem Überholen habe ich die Geschwindigkeit reduziert, aber plötzlich fuhr ein Fahrzeug in Gegenrichtung mit einem Schnitt durch die durchgehenden Linien auf mich zu. Um einen Zusammenstoß zu vermeiden, bog ich nach rechts ab und fuhr in Richtung der Autobahnarbeiter. Um einen Zusammenstoß mit ihnen zu vermeiden, bog ich in die Abzweigung ein. Ich konnte nicht viel verlangsamen, weil ich mich vor einem starken und unkontrollierten Ausbrechen auf dem Gras fürchtete. Um schwerwiegendere Folgen zu vermeiden, wurde mein Fahrzeug beschädigt und ist nicht reparierbar. Ich denke, dass der Schaden in Höhe von 180.000 CZK, insbesondere unter Berücksichtigung der Umstände, unter denen ich gezwungen war, anderen schwerwiegenden Folgen zu entgehen und in eine Abzweigung zu fahren.

src_text: F. W. Murnau's "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" is itself a remake - an unauthorized adaptation of "Dracula," Bram Stoker's compulsively readable fever dream of a novel - and Murnau and the screenwriter Henrik Galeen retained much of what was arresting about the original while slipping in their own major changes: They're responsible, for example, for the now-set-in-stone tradition that sunlight can destroy the vampire, a notion nowhere in Stoker's book. I likely saw "Nosferatu" at too impressionable an age. I was 6, PBS was showing such things and my babysitter was simply glad I wasn't burning down the house. But I would have been flattened by it whenever I saw it. It was like having felt a draft from a grave. (Its effects were so long-lasting that 30-something years later I published a novel inspired by the film and its production.) The whole thing wasn't so much petrifying as insidiously unsettling, and all of that started with the figure of Nosferatu himself. Max Schreck's performance is, 102 years later, still the benchmark for sinister and dignified repulsiveness. Schreck's vampire has the stillness of a figure in a bad dream or a spider on its web, and the world he inhabits is at times equally disconcerting. src_text: F. W. Murnau's "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" is itself a remake - an unauthorized adaptation of "Dracula," Bram Stoker's compulsively readable fever dream of a novel - and Murnau and the screenwriter Henrik Galeen retained much of what was arresting about the original while slipping in their own major changes: They're responsible, for example, for the now-set-in-stone tradition that sunlight can destroy the vampire, a notion nowhere in Stoker's book. I likely saw "Nosferatu" at too impressionable an age. I was 6, PBS was showing such things and my babysitter was simply glad I wasn't burning down the house. But I would have been flattened by it whenever I saw it. It was like having felt a draft from a grave. (Its effects were so long-lasting that 30-something years later I published a novel inspired by the film and its production.) The whole thing wasn't so much petrifying as insidiously unsettling, and all of that started with the figure of Nosferatu himself. Max Schreck's performance is, 102 years later, still the benchmark for sinister and dignified repulsiveness. Schreck's vampire has the stillness of a figure in a bad dream or a spider on its web, and the world he inhabits is at times equally disconcerting. After our hero Hutter's first frightening night in Nosferatu's castle, he notices in the mirror that something has bitten his neck, and he smiles.

src_text: But the most destabilizing figure might well be Hutter's wife, Ellen, our heroine, who's again and again shown to be telepathically on the monster's wavelength, even when he's thousands of miles away, so that polarities like good and evil or desire and repulsion seem to just evaporate while we watch. That last aspect alone would seem to land this story in Robert Eggers's wheelhouse. Part of the subversive energy of movies like "The Witch," "The Lighthouse" and "The Northman" derives from what feels like modern takes on historical characters in thrall to dark passions so that the distantly historical is both granted its strangeness and animated by a scrutinizing modern sensibility. At its best, his version both evokes and reconceives Murnau's most brilliant visual ideas. Murnau's masterful use of the opacities of dark archways from which the vampire can emerge and into which he can dissolve is both echoed and made new. Murnau's famously arresting use of shadows to visualize the vampire's defiling reach is reimagined when those shadows in this new version extend themselves in a 360-degree pan that evokes their vertiginous inescapability. And the shadow of the vampire's hand now extends across the entire city, repurposing the most memorable image from Murnau's "Faust."

src_text: I've always thought that one of the most insoluble aesthetic problems going is remaking a movie masterpiece. I certainly understand the impulse to passionately re-engage such a work, but if the definition of a masterwork is something peerless at what it sought to accomplish, how do you remake it without simply reiterating it? There's a reason no one has tried second versions of Fellini's "8½" or Coppola's "The Godfather" or Polanski's "Chinatown." In the case of Fellini's achievement, is someone going to produce a more harrowing portrait of the self-deluding toxicity of male narcissism? In the case of Coppola's, of the corrosive effects of power? Or in the case of Polanski's, of the Hey-nothing-personal malevolence of late-model capitalism? (Water itself in that movie turns out to be the commodity that's manipulated for profit.)
target_text: 映画の傑作をリメイクすることは、最も解決困難な美学上の問題の一つだと、私はかねてから思ってきた。そのような作品に情熱的に再び関わりたいという衝動はもちろん理解できるが、もし傑作の定義が、それが達成しようとしたことにおいて比類なきものであるとするならば、それを単に反復することなくして、どうやってリメイクできるというのだろうか。フェリーニの『8 1/2』、コッポラの『ゴッドファーザー』、ポランスキーの『チャイナタウン』の二番煎じに誰も挑んでこなかったのには理由がある。フェリーニの功績について言えば、自己欺瞞に満ちた男性ナルシシズムの有害性を、あれ以上に痛烈に描き出せる者がいるだろうか。コッポラの作品については、権力がもたらす腐敗の影響を。あるいはポランスキーの作品については、後期資本主義の「悪気はないんだ」と言わんばかりの悪意を。（あの映画では、水そのものが利益のために操作される商品と化すのだ。）

src_text: F. W. Murnau's "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" is itself a remake - an unauthorized adaptation of "Dracula," Bram Stoker's compulsively readable fever dream of a novel - and Murnau and the screenwriter Henrik Galeen retained much of what was arresting about the original while slipping in their own major changes: They're responsible, for example, for the now-set-in-stone tradition that sunlight can destroy the vampire, a notion nowhere in Stoker's book. I likely saw "Nosferatu" at too impressionable an age. I was 6, PBS was showing such things and my babysitter was simply glad I wasn't burning down the house. But I would have been flattened by it whenever I saw it. It was like having felt a draft from a grave. (Its effects were so long-lasting that 30-something years later I published a novel inspired by the film and its production.) The whole thing wasn't so much petrifying as insidiously unsettling, and all of that started with the figure of Nosferatu himself. Max Schreck's performance is, 102 years later, still the benchmark for sinister and dignified repulsiveness. Schreck's vampire has the stillness of a figure in a bad dream or a spider on its web, and the world he inhabits is at times equally disconcerting. After our hero Hutter's first frightening night in Nosferatu's castle, he notices in the mirror that something has bitten his neck, and he smiles.
target_text: F・W・ムルナウ監督の『ノスフェラトゥ』（原題：Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror）は、それ自体がリメイク作品である――ブラム・ストーカーの、熱にうなされた夢のようで一度読んだらやめられない小説『ドラキュラ』を無許可で翻案したものだ。ムルナウと脚本家のヘンリック・ガレーンは、原作の心を掴む部分の多くを維持しつつ、独自の大きな変更を忍び込ませた。例えば、今では定説となっている「太陽光が吸血鬼を滅ぼす」という伝統は彼らが生み出したもので、ストーカーの原作にはどこにも見られない発想である。私が『ノスフェラトゥ』を観たのは、おそらく多感すぎる年齢だっただろう。6歳の頃、PBS（公共放送サービス）がそういった作品を放映しており、ベビーシッターは私が家に火をつけさえしなければそれで満足だったのだ。しかし、いつ観たとしても私は打ちのめされていただろう。それはまるで、墓場から吹きつける隙間風を感じたかのようだった。（その影響は非常に長く続き、30数年後、私はこの映画とその製作に触発された小説を出版したほどだ。）作品全体は、石のように固まらせるというよりは、じわじわと心をかき乱すものであり、そのすべてはノスフェラトゥという存在そのものから始まっていた。マックス・シュレックの演技は、102年経った今でも、不気味で威厳のある醜悪さの基準となっている。シュレック演じる吸血鬼は、悪夢の中の登場人物や巣の上の蜘蛛のような静けさを湛えており、彼が生きる世界もまた、時に同様に不安を掻き立てる。主人公フッターがノスフェラトゥの城で最初の恐ろしい夜を過ごした後、彼は鏡を見て首を何者かに噛まれたことに気づき、そして微笑むのである。

src_text: South African opener Matthew Breetzke etched his name into the record books by becoming the first batter to score 150 runs on ODI debut in second match of the ongoing tri-series against New Zealand at the Gaddafi Stadium on Monday. His stunning knock of 150 off 148 balls, laced with 11 fours and five sixes, surpassed the previous record held by the legendary West Indies' batter Desmond Haynes, who scored 148 in his maiden ODI innings against Australia back in 1978. Before Breetzke's innings, the highest score on ODI debut for South Africa was 124 by Colin Ingram against Zimbabwe in 2010. Now, Breetzke stands alone at the top, delivering a performance that showcased patience, aggression, and remarkable shot selection as South Africa posted a mammoth 304/6.
target_text: Il battitore sudafricano Matthew Breetzke ha scritto la storia entrando nel libro dei record come il primo giocatore a realizzare 150 punti in una partita di ODI al suo esordio, durante il secondo incontro della tri-nazione in corso contro la Nuova Zelanda al Gaddafi Stadium lunedì. La sua straordinaria prestazione di 150 punti in 148 palle, con 11 quattro e cinque sei, ha superato il precedente record detenuto dal leggendario battitore delle Indie Occidentali Desmond Haynes, che aveva segnato 148 nel suo primo incontro ODI contro l'Australia nel 1978. Prima dell'ingresso in scena di Breetzke, il miglior punteggio in una ODI al debutto per il Sudafrica era stato 124 realizzati da Colin Ingram contro lo Zimbabwe nel 2010. Ora, Breetzke è solo in vetta, con una performance che ha mostrato pazienza, aggressività e una straordinaria scelta dei colpi, permettendo al Sudafrica di chiudere con un imponente totale di 304/6.

src_text: South African opener Matthew Breetzke etched his name into the record books by becoming the first batter to score 150 runs on ODI debut in second match of the ongoing tri-series against New Zealand at the Gaddafi Stadium on Monday. His stunning knock of 150 off 148 balls, laced with 11 fours and five sixes, surpassed the previous record held by the legendary West Indies' batter Desmond Haynes, who scored 148 in his maiden ODI innings against Australia back in 1978. Before Breetzke's innings, the highest score on ODI debut for South Africa was 124 by Colin Ingram against Zimbabwe in 2010. Now, Breetzke stands alone at the top, delivering a performance that showcased patience, aggression, and remarkable shot selection as South Africa posted a mammoth 304/6.
target_text: Jihoafrický otevírající pálkař Matthew Breetzke se zapsal do historie, když se stal prvním hráčem, který vstřelil 150 běhů při svém debutu v ODI v druhém zápase probíhajícího tri-série proti Novému Zélandu na stadionu Gaddafi v pondělí. Jeho ohromující výkon 150 běhů ze 148 míčů, doplněný 11 čtyřmi a pěti šesticemi, překonal předchozí rekord legendárního západnoindického pálkaře Desmonda Haynese, který vstřelil 148 běhů ve svém prvním ODI iningu proti Austrálii v roce 1978. Před Breetzkeho výkonem bylo nejvyšší skóre při debutu v ODI za Jihoafrickou republiku 124 běhů, které zaznamenal Colin Ingram proti Zimbabwe v roce 2010. Nyní Breetzke stojí osamocen na vrcholu a předvedl výkon, který demonstroval trpělivost, agresivitu a pozoruhodný výběr úderů, zatímco Jihoafrická republika dosáhla obrovského skóre 304/6.

src_text: When it comes to those who have waded into that kind of deep water, some have tried the Let's-really-shake-things-up solution. There's the lamentable 1962 remake of "The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari," for instance, which not only eliminated the central figure of Cesare the somnambulist but also featured a Caligari who instead of practicing diabolic hypnotism spent his time showing the heroine offensive pictures. Other filmmakers have chosen the even more baffling route of changing almost nothing, such as Gus Van Sant's nearly shot-for-shot 1998 remake of "Psycho." The number of disappointed moviegoers you risk in remaking a masterpiece from 1922 is smaller, for obvious reasons, but even so, the director Robert Eggers has made clear in any number of interviews his understanding that his new "Nosferatu" is re-engaging one of the greatest of the silent movies. (In 2016, when he was first attempting to remake the film, he told an interviewer that it felt "ugly and blasphemous and egomaniacal and disgusting" to take up that project so early into his career.)
target_text: このような深淵な領域に踏み込んだ監督たちの中には、徹底的に変革を試みた者もいる。例えば1962年に製作された『カリガリ博士』の悲惨なリメイク版では、夢遊病者チェザーレという中心的人物を抹消しただけでなく、悪魔的な催眠術を使うはずのカリガリ博士が、代わりにヒロインに不快な写真を見せるような人物として描かれていた。他の監督たちはさらに不可解なアプローチを選び、ガス・ヴァン・サントが1998年にほぼショットごとに忠実にリメイクした『サイコ』のように、ほとんど何も変更しない道を選んだ。1922年公開の名作をリメイクする場合、当然ながら失望する観客の数は相対的に少なくなるが、それでも監督のロバート・エガースは、数多くのインタビューで、自身の新作『ノスフェラトゥ』が無声映画の傑作の一つと再び向き合う試みであることを明らかにしている。（2016年、彼が最初にこの映画のリメイクに着手した際、キャリアの早い段階でこのプロジェクトに取り組むことは「醜く冒涜的で自己陶酔的で不快なこと」だとインタビューで語っている）。

src_text: But the most destabilizing figure might well be Hutter's wife, Ellen, our heroine, who's again and again shown to be telepathically on the monster's wavelength, even when he's thousands of miles away, so that polarities like good and evil or desire and repulsion seem to just evaporate while we watch. That last aspect alone would seem to land this story in Robert Eggers's wheelhouse. Part of the subversive energy of movies like "The Witch," "The Lighthouse" and "The Northman" derives from what feels like modern takes on historical characters in thrall to dark passions so that the distantly historical is both granted its strangeness and animated by a scrutinizing modern sensibility. At its best, his version both evokes and reconceives Murnau's most brilliant visual ideas. Murnau's masterful use of the opacities of dark archways from which the vampire can emerge and into which he can dissolve is both echoed and made new. Murnau's famously arresting use of shadows to visualize the vampire's defiling reach is reimagined when those shadows in this new version extend themselves in a 360-degree pan that evokes their vertiginous inescapability. And the shadow of the vampire's hand now extends across the entire city, repurposing the most memorable image from Murnau's "Faust."
target_text: Kuid Hutteri naise Elleni, meie kangelanna, kuju võib olla kõige destabiliseerivam. Näeme, et tal on monstrumiga telepaatiline side, isegi kui nad asuvad tuhandeid kilomeetreid üksteisest eemal, ja nii tundub, et headuse ja kurjuse või ihaldatuse ja jälestuse polaarvastandused justkui haihtuvad, kui me seda pealt vaatame. Üksnes see aspekt viitab sellele, et tegemist on filmiga, mis võiks olla Robert Eggersi valdkond. Osa filmide „Nõid“, „Majakas“ ja „Põhjakonn“ pöördelisest energiast tuleb just sellest, et tundub, nagu oleks tegemist tänapäevaste versioonidega ajaloolistest tegelaskujudest, keda juhib pime kirg, muutes ammu toimunud sündmused veidraks ja samal ajal huvitavaks tänapäevase maailmavaate abil. Tema versioon kutsub esile ja käsitleb taas Murnaui geniaalseid visuaalseid ideid. Murnaui oskuslikult kasutatavad tumedad käigud, millest vampiir ilmub välja ja neisse kaob, on edasi antud uues võtmes, Murnaui kuulsat varjudega tööd vampiiri hävitava haarde visualiseerimisel taasluues, kui need varjud sellesse uude versiooni ulatuvad 360-kraadise panoraamina, mis annab edasi nende ebameeldivat vältimatust. Ja vampiiri käe vari katab nüüd kogu linna, kasutades uuesti Murnaui filmis „Fausti“ kõige meeldejäävamat kujutist.

src_text: I've always thought that one of the most insoluble aesthetic problems going is remaking a movie masterpiece. I certainly understand the impulse to passionately re-engage such a work, but if the definition of a masterwork is something peerless at what it sought to accomplish, how do you remake it without simply reiterating it? There's a reason no one has tried second versions of Fellini's "8½" or Coppola's "The Godfather" or Polanski's "Chinatown." In the case of Fellini's achievement, is someone going to produce a more harrowing portrait of the self-deluding toxicity of male narcissism? In the case of Coppola's, of the corrosive effects of power? Or in the case of Polanski's, of the Hey-nothing-personal malevolence of late-model capitalism? (Water itself in that movie turns out to be the commodity that's manipulated for profit.)
target_text: Vždy jsem si myslel, že jedním z nejobtížněji řešitelných estetických problémů je předělání filmového mistrovského díla. Naprosto chápu touhu znovu se s takovým dílem vášnivě vypořádat, ale pokud je definicí mistrovského díla něco, co je jedinečné v tom, čeho chtělo dosáhnout, jak jej můžete předělat, aniž byste jej pouze opakovali? Existuje důvod, proč se nikdo nepokusil o druhou verzi Felliniho „8½“, Coppolova „Kmotr“ nebo Polanského „Čínská čtvrť“. V případě Felliniho díla – dokáže někdo vytvořit ještě děsivější portrét sebeklamné toxicity mužského narcismu? V případě Coppoly – ještě pronikavější pohled na korozivní účinky moci? Nebo v případě Polanského – na bezosobní zlovolnost pozdního kapitalismu? (V tom filmu se nakonec ukáže, že i samotná voda je komoditou, s níž se manipuluje kvůli zisku.)

Dne 20.06. kolem 10:30 jsem se vydal z Kolína směrem na Prahu po silnice. Po skončení úseku s kamerami v oblasti Úval, při předjíždění aut vpředu jsem překročil rychlost 90 km/h, rozumím tomu, ale nikoho jsem ne omezil a neohrožil, po předjetí jsem shodil rychlost, ale najednou v protisměru, s průsečíkem plných čar, vyjelo vozidlo na mně. Abych se vyhnul srážce, zatočil jsem doprava a pokračoval směrem k pracovníkům na dálnici. Abych se vyhnul srážce s nimi, jsem zatočil do odbočky.
Nemohl jsem moc zpomalit, protože jsem se bál silného a nekontrolovaného smyku na trávě. Z důvodu, abych zabránil vážnějším následkům, bylo mé vozidlo poškozeno a není opravitelné.. Myslím si, že poškození ve výši 180 000 Kč , zejména s ohledem na okolnosti, kdy jsem byl nucen se vyhnout jiným vážným následkům a odjet do odbočky.
target_text:
Am 20.06. gegen 10:30 Uhr fuhr ich von Kolín in Richtung Prag auf der Straße los. Nach dem Ende des Abschnitts mit Kameras im Bereich Úval überholte ich vor mir fahrende Autos und überschritt dabei die Geschwindigkeit von 90 km/h. Ich verstehe das, aber ich habe niemanden behindert oder gefährdet. Nach dem Überholen reduzierte ich die Geschwindigkeit, doch plötzlich kam mir ein Fahrzeug entgegen, das die durchgezogene Linie überschritt. Um einen Zusammenstoß zu vermeiden, lenkte ich nach rechts und fuhr in Richtung der Arbeiter auf der Autobahn. Um eine Kollision mit ihnen zu verhindern, bog ich in eine Ausfahrt ein.  
Ich konnte nicht stark abbremsen, da ich Angst vor einem starken und unkontrollierten Schleudern auf dem Gras hatte. Um schwerwiegendere Folgen zu vermeiden, wurde mein Fahrzeug beschädigt und ist nicht mehr reparierbar. Ich schätze den Schaden auf etwa 180.000 CZK, insbesondere unter Berücksichtigung der Umstände, dass ich gezwungen war, anderen schweren Folgen auszuweichen und in die Ausfahrt zu fahren.

Trojcípý šátek.
Používá se k zavěšení, pokud se zlomenina nachází na horní končetině.
Při zlomenině v oblasti pánve je nutné uložit zraněného do stabilizované polohy a co nejrychleji odvézt k lékaři.
Zlomeniny se dělí na zavřené a volné.
Dlaha musí jít vždy přes dva klouby, jeden nad a jeden pod zlomeným místem.
Úlomek kosti vyčnívající z rány musí být sterilně zakryt.
Zavřená zlomenina je taková, kdy kůže nad zlomeninou není porušena.
Jako dlahu lze použít vše, co máme po ruce, např. opasek.
Při zlomenině končetiny je potřeba nejprve vrátit končetinu do původní polohy.
Pokud dojde ke zlomenině v zimě, zásadně nesundáváme oděvy, boty či rukavice, aby oteklá tkáň neomrzla.
V nouzovém případě je možné končetinu znehybnit tím, že ji přivážeme k druhé končetině.

Dreiecktuch.  
Es wird zum Aufhängen verwendet, wenn der Bruch an einer oberen Gliedmaße liegt.  
Bei einem Beckenbruch muss der Verletzte in eine stabilisierte Position gebracht und so schnell wie möglich zum Arzt transportiert werden.  
Brüche werden in geschlossene und offene Brüche unterteilt.  
Eine Schiene muss immer über zwei Gelenke verlaufen – eines oberhalb und eines unterhalb der Bruchstelle.  
Ein aus der Wunde herausragendes Knochenfragment muss steril abgedeckt werden.  
Ein geschlossener Bruch liegt vor, wenn die Haut über dem Bruch nicht verletzt ist.  
Als Schiene kann alles verwendet werden, was wir griffbereit haben – zum Beispiel ein Gürtel.  
Bei einem Gliedmaßenbruch ist es zunächst notwendig, das Gliedmaß in seine ursprüngliche Position zurückzubringen.  
Wenn ein Bruch im Winter auftritt, entfernen wir grundsätzlich keine Kleidung, Schuhe oder Handschuhe, um zu verhindern, dass das geschwollene Gewebe erfriert.  
In Notfällen kann ein Gliedmaß immobilisiert werden, indem es an ein anderes Gliedmaß gebunden wird.

src_text: I've always thought that one of the most insoluble aesthetic problems going is remaking a movie masterpiece. I certainly understand the impulse to passionately re-engage such a work, but if the definition of a masterwork is something peerless at what it sought to accomplish, how do you remake it without simply reiterating it? There's a reason no one has tried second versions of Fellini's "8½" or Coppola's "The Godfather" or Polanski's "Chinatown." In the case of Fellini's achievement, is someone going to produce a more harrowing portrait of the self-deluding toxicity of male narcissism? In the case of Coppola's, of the corrosive effects of power? Or in the case of Polanski's, of the Hey-nothing-personal malevolence of late-model capitalism? (Water itself in that movie turns out to be the commodity that's manipulated for profit.)
target_text: 我一直认为，最难解决的美学问题之一就是重拍一部电影杰作。我当然理解人们对重新投入这样一部作品的冲动，但如果杰作的定义是指在所追求的目标上无与伦比的作品，那么如何重拍它而不简单地重复它呢？没有人尝试过重拍费里尼的《甜蜜生活》、科波拉的《教父》或波兰斯基的《唐人街》是有原因的。就费里尼的成就而言，有人会制作一部更令人心碎的关于男性自恋的自我欺骗毒性的肖像吗？就科波拉而言，关于权力的腐蚀性？或者就波兰斯基而言，关于晚期资本主义的无个人恶意？（在电影中，水本身被证明是为利润而操纵的商品。）

src_text: South African opener Matthew Breetzke etched his name into the record books by becoming the first batter to score 150 runs on ODI debut in second match of the ongoing tri-series against New Zealand at the Gaddafi Stadium on Monday. His stunning knock of 150 off 148 balls, laced with 11 fours and five sixes, surpassed the previous record held by the legendary West Indies' batter Desmond Haynes, who scored 148 in his maiden ODI innings against Australia back in 1978. Before Breetzke's innings, the highest score on ODI debut for South Africa was 124 by Colin Ingram against Zimbabwe in 2010. Now, Breetzke stands alone at the top, delivering a performance that showcased patience, aggression, and remarkable shot selection as South Africa posted a mammoth 304/6.
target_text: Il battitore di apertura sudafricano Matthew Breetzke ha iscritto il suo nome nei libri dei record, diventando il primo battitore a segnare 150 punti al suo debutto in un ODI nella seconda partita del torneo triangolare in corso contro la Nuova Zelanda, disputatasi lunedì al Gaddafi Stadium. La sua straordinaria prestazione da 150 punti in 148 palle, impreziosita da 11 "four" e cinque "six", ha superato il precedente record detenuto dal leggendario battitore delle Indie Occidentali Desmond Haynes, che nel 1978 segnò 148 punti nel suo primo inning in un ODI contro l'Australia. Prima dell'inning di Breetzke, il punteggio più alto al debutto in un ODI per il Sudafrica era di 124 punti, realizzato da Colin Ingram contro lo Zimbabwe nel 2010. Ora, Breetzke si trova da solo in vetta, grazie a una performance che ha messo in mostra pazienza, aggressività e una notevole selezione dei colpi, portando il Sudafrica a un imponente totale di 304/6.

Při zlomenině končetiny je potřeba nejprve vrátit končetinu do původní polohy.
Pokud dojde ke zlomenině v zimě, zásadně nesundáváme oděvy, boty či rukavice, aby oteklá tkáň neomrzla.

src_text: South African opener Matthew Breetzke etched his name into the record books by becoming the first batter to score 150 runs on ODI debut in second match of the ongoing tri-series against New Zealand at the Gaddafi Stadium on Monday. His stunning knock of 150 off 148 balls, laced with 11 fours and five sixes, surpassed the previous record held by the legendary West Indies' batter Desmond Haynes, who scored 148 in his maiden ODI innings against Australia back in 1978. Before Breetzke's innings, the highest score on ODI debut for South Africa was 124 by Colin Ingram against Zimbabwe in 2010. Now, Breetzke stands alone at the top, delivering a performance that showcased patience, aggression, and remarkable shot selection as South Africa posted a mammoth 304/6.
target_text: Lõuna-Aafrika mängija Matthew Breetzke jõudis ajalukku, kui ta sai esimeseks mängijaks, kes saavutas ühe päeva rahvusvahelisel (ODI) debüütmängul 150 punkti. See juhtus esmaspäeval Pakistanis, Lahores asuvas Gaddafi staadionil, kui mängiti kolme meeskonna turniiril Uus-Meremaa vastu. Tema suurepärane 150 punktiline esitus 148 pallilt, mis sisaldas 11 neljast ja viit kuuest, ületas varasema rekordi, millele kuulus legendaarne Lääne-India mängija Desmond Haynes, kes saavutas 148 punkti oma esimeses ODI mängus Austraalia vastu juba 1978. aastal. Enne Breetzke'i esitust oli kõrgeim punktisumma Lõuna-Aafrika jaoks ODI debüütmängul 124 punkti, mille saavutas Colin Ingram Zimbabwe'i vastu 2010. aastal. Nüüd on Breetzke ainus selle rekordi omanik, olles näidanud suurepärast kannatlikkust, agressiivsust ja suurepärast löögivalikut, aidates Lõuna-Aafrikal saavutada muljetavaldav 304/6.

src_text: I've always thought that one of the most insoluble aesthetic problems going is remaking a movie masterpiece. I certainly understand the impulse to passionately re-engage such a work, but if the definition of a masterwork is something peerless at what it sought to accomplish, how do you remake it without simply reiterating it? There's a reason no one has tried second versions of Fellini's "8½" or Coppola's "The Godfather" or Polanski's "Chinatown." In the case of Fellini's achievement, is someone going to produce a more harrowing portrait of the self-deluding toxicity of male narcissism? In the case of Coppola's, of the corrosive effects of power? Or in the case of Polanski's, of the Hey-nothing-personal malevolence of late-model capitalism? That last aspect alone would seem to land this story in Robert Eggers's wheelhouse. Part of the subversive energy of movies like "The Witch," "The Lighthouse" and "The Northman" derives from what feels like modern takes on historical characters in thrall to dark passions so that the distantly historical is both granted its strangeness and animated by a scrutinizing modern sensibility. Murnau's masterful use of the opacities of dark archways from which the vampire can emerge and into which he can dissolve is both echoed and made new. Murnau's famously arresting use of shadows to visualize the vampire's defiling reach is reimagined when those shadows in this new version extend themselves in a 360-degree pan that evokes their vertiginous inescapability. And the shadow of the vampire's hand now extends across the entire city, repurposing the most memorable image from Murnau's "Faust."

Dlaha musí jít vždy přes dva klouby, jeden nad a jeden pod zlomeným místem.

Zavřená zlomenina je taková, kdy kůže nad zlomeninou není porušena.
Jako dlahu lze použít vše, co máme po ruce, např. opasek.
Při zlomenině končetiny je potřeba nejprve vrátit končetinu do původní polohy.
Pokud dojde ke zlomenině v zimě, zásadně nesundáváme oděvy, boty či rukavice, aby oteklá tkáň neomrzla.
V nouzovém případě je možné končetinu znehybnit tím, že ji přivážeme k druhé končetině.

Es wird zum Aufhängen verwendet, wenn sich der Bruch an der oberen Extremität befindet.  
Bei einem Bruch im Beckenbereich muss der Verletzte in die stabile Seitenlage gebracht und so schnell wie möglich zum Arzt transportiert werden.  
Brüche werden in geschlossene und offene unterteilt.  
Die Schiene muss immer über zwei Gelenke gehen, eines oberhalb und eines unterhalb der Bruchstelle.  
Ein aus der Wunde herausragender Knochensplitter muss steril abgedeckt werden.  
Ein geschlossener Bruch liegt vor, wenn die Haut über dem Bruch nicht verletzt ist.  
Als Schiene kann alles verwendet werden, was zur Hand ist, z. B. ein Gürtel.  
Bei einem Bruch einer Gliedmaße muss diese zunächst in ihre ursprüngliche Position zurückgebracht werden.  
Kommt es im Winter zu einem Bruch, dürfen Kleidung, Schuhe oder Handschuhe auf keinen Fall ausgezogen werden, damit das angeschwollene Gewebe nicht erfriert.  
Im Notfall kann die Gliedmaße dadurch ruhiggestellt werden, dass sie an die andere Gliedmaße angebunden wird.

src_text: F. W. Murnau's "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" is itself a remake - an unauthorized adaptation of "Dracula," Bram Stoker's compulsively readable fever dream of a novel - and Murnau and the screenwriter Henrik Galeen retained much of what was arresting about the original while slipping in their own major changes: They're responsible, for example, for the now-set-in-stone tradition that sunlight can destroy the vampire, a notion nowhere in Stoker's book. I likely saw "Nosferatu" at too impressionable an age. I was 6, PBS was showing such things and my babysitter was simply glad I wasn't burning down the house. But I would have been flattened by it whenever I saw it. It was like having felt a draft from a grave. (Its effects were so long-lasting that 30-something years later I published a novel inspired by the film and its production.) The whole thing wasn't so much petrifying as insidiously unsettling, and all of that started with the figure of Nosferatu himself. Max Schreck's performance is, 102 years later, still the benchmark for sinister and dignified repulsiveness. Schreck's vampire has the stillness of a figure in a bad dream or a spider on its web, and the world he inhabits is at times equally disconcerting. After our hero Hutter's first frightening night in Nosferatu's castle, he notices in the mirror that something has bitten his neck, and he smiles.
target_text: Филм "Носферату: Симфонија ужаса" режисера Ф. В. Мурнауа је сам по себи римејк – неауторизована адаптација романа "Дракула" Брама Стокера, који је изузетно узбудљив и интригантан – а Мурнау и сценариста Хенрик Галеен су задржали многе елементе који су били импресивни у оригиналу, уз истовремено уношење значајних сопствених измена: На пример, они су заслужни за сада већ устаљену традицију да сунчева светлост може уништити вампира, што се нигде не помиње у Стокеровој књизи. Вероватно сам "Носферату" погледао у превише раним годинама. Имао сам шест година, телевизија ПБС је приказивала такве филмове, а моја дадиља је била само срећна што нисам запалио кућу. Али, сигурно бих био шокиран без обзира када бих га погледао. Било је то као да сам осетио хладан ваздух из гроба. (Утисак је био толико снажан да сам, тридесетак година касније, објавио роман инспирисан филмом и његовом продукцијом.) Цела прича није била толико застрашујућа колико подмукло узнемирујућа, а све је почело са ликом Носфератуа. Глума Макса Шрека је, чак и 102 године касније, и даље мерило за злокобну и достојанствену одвратност. src_text: I've always thought that one of the most insoluble aesthetic problems going is remaking a movie masterpiece. I certainly understand the impulse to passionately re-engage such a work, but if the definition of a masterwork is something peerless at what it sought to accomplish, how do you remake it without simply reiterating it? There's a reason no one has tried second versions of Fellini's "8½" or Coppola's "The Godfather" or Polanski's "Chinatown." In the case of Fellini's achievement, is someone going to produce a more harrowing portrait of the self-deluding toxicity of male narcissism? In the case of Coppola's, of the corrosive effects of power? Or in the case of Polanski's, of the Hey-nothing-personal malevolence of late-model capitalism? (Water itself in that movie turns out to be the commodity that's manipulated for profit.)

src_text: I've always thought that one of the most insoluble aesthetic problems going is remaking a movie masterpiece. I certainly understand the impulse to passionately re-engage such a work, but if the definition of a masterwork is something peerless at what it sought to accomplish, how do you remake it without simply reiterating it? There's a reason no one has tried second versions of Fellini's "8½" or Coppola's "The Godfather" or Polanski's "Chinatown." In the case of Fellini's achievement, is someone going to produce a more harrowing portrait of the self-deluding toxicity of male narcissism? In the case of Coppola's, of the corrosive effects of power? Or in the case of Polanski's, of the Hey-nothing-personal malevolence of late-model capitalism? (Water itself in that movie turns out to be the commodity that's manipulated for profit.)
target_text: 私は、映画の名作をリメイクすることが、最も解決困難な美学的課題の一つであると常々考えてきました。もちろん、そのような作品に情熱的に再び取り組もうとする衝動は理解できますが、名作とはその目的において比類のないものであると定義されるのであれば、それを単なる繰り返しではなく、どのようにリメイクすればよいのでしょうか？フェリーニの『8 1/2』、コッポラの『ゴッドファーザー』、ポランスキーの『チャイナタウン』の第二版を誰も試みなかったのには理由があります。フェリーニの業績の場合、誰かが男性のナルシシズムの自己欺瞞的な毒性を、より恐ろしく描くことができるでしょうか？コッポラの場合、権力の腐敗的な影響を？ポランスキーの場合、現代資本主義の、個人的ではない悪意を？（その映画では、水そのものが利益のために操作される商品であることが明らかになります。）

Murnau's "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror" is itself a remake - an unauthorized adaptation of "Dracula," Bram Stoker's compulsively readable fever dream of a novel - and Murnau and the screenwriter Henrik Galeen retained much of what was arresting about the original while slipping in their own major changes: They're responsible, for example, for the now-set-in-stone tradition that sunlight can destroy the vampire, a notion nowhere in Stoker's book. I likely saw "Nosferatu" at too impressionable an age. I was 6, PBS was showing such things and my babysitter was simply glad I wasn't burning down the house. But I would have been flattened by it whenever I saw it. It was like having felt a draft from a grave. (Its effects were so long-lasting that 30-something years later I published a novel inspired by the film and its production.) The whole thing wasn't so much petrifying as insidiously unsettling, and all of that started with the figure of Nosferatu himself. Max Schreck's performance is, 102 years later, still the benchmark for sinister and dignified repulsiveness. Schreck's vampire has the stillness of a figure in a bad dream or a spider on its web, and the world he inhabits is at times equally disconcerting. After our hero Hutter's first frightening night in Nosferatu's castle, he notices in the mirror that something has bitten his neck, and he smiles.

target_text: F・W・ムルナウの『ノスフェラトゥ 恐怖の交響曲』それ自体もリメイク作品である。ブラム・ストーカーの読まずにはいられない幻想的な小説『ドラキュラ』の無許可翻案であり、ムルナウと脚本家ヘンリック・ガレーンは原作の強烈な魅力の多くを保持しつつ、独自の大幅な改変を加えている。例えば彼らが責任を負っているのは、吸血鬼を日光で滅ぼせるという現在では定説となっている概念であり、これは原作のストーカーの小説には存在しない発想だ。私はおそらく、まだ感受性が鋭敏すぎる時期に『ノスフェラトゥ』を観てしまったのだろう。当時6歳で、PBSがこのような作品を放送しており、ベビーシッターは私が家を燃やさなければどんな作品でも構わないと思っていた。しかし何度観ても完全に打ちのめされた。それは墓場から吹き込む冷気のような衝撃だった（その影響は非常に長く続き、30年以上経った後に私はこの映画とその制作に着想を得た小説を出版することになった）。この作品が単に恐怖を与えるだけでなく、狡猾に不安を掻き立てる性質を持っていたのは、すべてノスフェラトゥという人物に由来する。マックス・シュレックの演技は、102年経った今もなお、邪悪でありながら威厳に満ちた嫌悪感の基準点であり続けている。シュレックの吸血鬼は、悪夢の中の人物や蜘蛛が巣にいる時のような静けさを持ち、彼が生きる世界も時に同様に不気味である。主人公フーターがノスフェラトゥの城で初めて恐怖に震える夜を過ごし、鏡を見て首に何かに噛まれた跡があることに気づいた時、彼は微笑んだのだった。

Takhle vypadá ten meloun, co se vám ukazoval vevnitř. Jak můžete vidět, tak je krásně červeně zbarvený. Třeba ty nedozrálý melouny jsou vlastně, ta bílá barva už jde víc dovnitř a jsou světlejší, nebo třeba už jenom bílý na okrajích. A třeba zase naopak přezrálý meloun bude takový, jakoby houba, že nebude vůbec pevný. A jak vidíte, já ho vlastně jenom takhle s žíčkou, že se ho vydloubu a vidíte, že není vůbec měký, že je krásně tvrdý a pro mě ideální. Co ale taková chuť?
target_text: Або, власне, можемо піти в якийсь інший магазин, і там вам пощастить купити навіть дешевший кавун, який коштує по 10 кг і буде чудовий. Ось так виглядає той кавун, що я вам показував всередині. Як можете бачити, він гарно червоний всередині. Наприклад, недостиглі кавуни — у них білий колір заходить глибше всередину і вони світліші, або навіть просто білі по краях. А, наприклад, навпаки, перестиглий кавун буде такий, як губка, зовсім не твердий. І як бачите, я його просто так ложкою — вибираю, і бачите, що він зовсім не м’який, він гарно твердий і для мене ідеальний. А що ж щодо смаку?
